description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of global and project workflows. If workflow names are specified in the query string, details of those workflows are returned. Otherwise, all workflows are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:**

 *  *Administer Jira* global permission to access all, including project-scoped, workflows
 *  At least one of the *Administer projects* and *View (read-only) workflow* project permissions to access project-scoped workflows

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description:
Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expand options include:

 *  `values.transitions` Returns the transitions that each workflow is associated with.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with workflow name.
parameters.name: queryString

parameters.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `name` Sorts by workflow name.
 *  `created` Sorts by create time.
 *  `updated` Sorts by update time.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description: The scope of the workflow. Global for company-managed projects and Project for team-managed projects.
parameters.name: scope

parameters.description: The ID of the project to filter the workflows by. Only workflows associated with the given project are returned.
parameters.name: projectId

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing, or the caller doesn't have permissions to perform the operation.
